description: Your data, written up as a front page. Bind a category (branch, region, product), a measure and a month. SmartVisuals Newspaper finds the stories in the numbers - Chicago pulls ahead of Milwaukee, Manchester falls 9%, total revenue rises 3.8% - ranks them like an editor and prints a front page: masthead, lead story with headline, deck and chart, columns of stories, a briefs column and a numbers table. Written by the visual, offline. Every headline comes from deterministic templates inside the visual. No AI service, no external call, nothing leaves the report: the same data always gives the same page, so PDF and PowerPoint exports and email subscriptions say exactly what the screen said. Honest copy. It reports what the numbers did and never claims why. No record without six periods of history, no streak under three, no percentage on a zero base, totals compared like for like, ties called level. Costs read the right way round, averages and percentages are never summed. Hover any story for the numbers behind it and "How this was written". Free - the front page: Lead change, leader and lead margin, biggest rise and fall, total, share of the top three Broadsheet, tabloid and digest layouts that fit the tile; Boardroom mode with bars and a trend Lower is better, measure type, leave categories out, dynamic format strings Conditional formatting (fx) on bar colours Cross-highlight and…
